MEMORY_UPDATE/v1

2026-09-11 — Project Office / runner substrate update

- `FREE-INFERENCE-RUNNER-0001` (#115) reached strict `TASK_COMPLETED` with reviewable PR #117 at exact head `b6a275d5ca3455b2d7de6dc3d23c50fa171c4235`; verdict `RUNNER_READY`.
- The tested asset is a local-first restart-safe SQLite-WAL worker with duplicate/restart idempotency, explicit private/public routing, fail-closed paid-mode guard, sanitized receipts, and `worker-capability-card/v1`. Local Ollama/Gemma uses the bounded `think:false` path; external inference remains a narrow adapter capability and is deliberately `auth_required` when no authorized provider capability exists. No account, credential, billing, or public listener was changed.
- This is now a plausible substrate for future Founder Agent / LP-agent work contracts, but it is not yet an external/free-provider lane and does not itself authorize provider onboarding.
- `PROJECT-OFFICE-0001` (#114) on Darwin was a technical execution blockage, not a venture-methodology verdict: exit 0, zero published artifacts, strict `TASK_BLOCKED`. Do not rerun it for cosmetics.
- One bounded recovery successor was materialized as #119 `PROJECT-OFFICE-0002` on Wolfram. Its required result is the shadow `IDEA -> RP -> RESEARCH[] -> SYNTHESIS -> IC_DECISION -> FOUNDER_CHARTER -> PROJECT_STATUS` pipeline plus a portable Research Library bundle usable by an ordinary Chat/Gemini research agent without mailbox-specific knowledge.

No production Founder scheduler, LP allocation, provider credential, or external publication is authorized by this update.
